name: Preserve student profile and issue passes later
description: Verifies the existing profile-first workflow still saves a student without passes and later issues event passes.
steps: Add two events
Save a student profile without issuing passes
Edit the student, select events, enter payment, and issue passes
expected: The student remains saved, allocations are created only when issuance is selected, and the QR PDF bundle is generated.

name: Bulk allocate complimentary passes within event quota
description: Verifies multiple students can receive passes at once and complimentary allocations consume the event-specific free-pass quota.
steps: Create an event with 10 received passes and 3 complimentary passes allowed
Open Bulk Allocate Passes, select the event/day, search a student by name, select three students, and verify the selected count and total passes
Use Select All or Deselect All as needed, set Passes per student to 1, enable Complimentary, and allocate the selected students
expected: The bulk screen calculates selected students × quantity, already-allocated students are disabled for that event, and the three selected students receive three passes without exceeding inventory or complimentary quota.

name: Shared data persists across app contexts
description: Verifies the app loads shared records from the backend instead of relying only on one browser storage container.
steps: Create a student and event
Refresh the live app
Open the same app from its installed home-screen web-app context
expected: The same student and event records are available in every app context because they are stored in the shared backend.

name: Record payment and keep complimentary value separate
description: Verifies paid allocations record collection while complimentary allocations remain zero-value and separately counted.
steps: Issue one paid pass and record a partial payment
Issue one complimentary pass from an event with a complimentary quota
Open Payments and Reports
expected: The paid allocation shows collection and pending balance; the complimentary allocation shows zero sales value and is separately identified.

name: Delete a pass allocation with confirmation
description: Verifies existing deletion behavior remains intact after the shared-state and allocation changes.
steps: Create an issued pass with a linked payment
Delete the allocation and cancel once
Delete it again and confirm
expected: Cancel preserves the pass; confirmation removes the allocation and its linked payment while the student and event remain.

name: Import student profiles from Excel
covers: student profile creation from name and mobile
no pass or payment creation during student import
description: Verifies the dedicated student importer creates profiles from Student Name and Mobile Number without creating allocations or payments.
steps: Open Import Students and upload an Excel file containing Student Name and Mobile Number
Upload the same file again
Open Students and review the imported profiles
expected: Each valid mobile number creates one student profile; duplicate mobile numbers are skipped and no passes or payments are created by the import.

name: Cloud state is authoritative across browser contexts
description: Verifies a deleted student does not return from an older Home Screen or browser local cache after shared cloud state refresh.
steps: Create a student and allocation
Delete the student from one app context
Open or refresh another existing app context with an older local cache
Wait for realtime or shared refresh
expected: The second context reflects the cloud state and does not resurrect the deleted student, allocation, or linked payment.

name: Delete student and cascade linked passes and payments
description: Verifies deleting a student removes the student, all linked pass allocations, and all linked payments while preserving unrelated students and events.
steps: Create a student with allocated passes and at least one linked payment
Delete the student and confirm the destructive action
Open Students, Pass Allocations, Payments, and event inventory
expected: The student, their allocations, and linked payments are gone; unrelated records remain and the deleted pass quantities are available again in the relevant event inventory.

name: Keep Navratri Day 1 to Day 9 unique after cloud sync
description: Verifies duplicate cloud/local copies of Day 1 to Day 9 collapse into one event per day without losing allocations.
steps: Open the app after shared data sync
Open Events
Open Passes and review any existing allocations
expected: Each Navratri day from Day 1 through Day 9 appears only once, and existing allocations remain attached to the retained event.

name: Review screenshot student import with name plus mobile duplicate protection
covers: different names with same mobile remain separate
student-only import without passes or payments
description: Verifies screenshot student import opens a review screen, applies the name-plus-mobile duplicate rule, and only saves confirmed student profiles.
steps: Open Import Students
Choose Upload Screenshot and select a clear screenshot containing student names and mobile numbers
Review the extracted rows and confirm the duplicate statuses
Add the selected students
Open Students and verify the added profiles
expected: The screenshot is parsed into editable student rows; exact same name plus mobile duplicates are not selected, different names sharing one mobile can both be added, and no passes or payments are created.

name: Show student and pass counts on the home dashboard
description: Verifies the home dashboard shows the current student count alongside event, pass, collection, pending, and expense totals.
steps: Create two student profiles and an event with 10 received passes
Issue three passes and record a payment
Open the Home dashboard
expected: The dashboard shows 2 total students, 10 passes received, 3 passes issued, 7 passes remaining, and current collection, pending collection, and expense totals.

name: Save and edit different pass quantities per day
covers: student save with common quantity greater than one
single-scan handover of the allocated quantity
description: Verifies a student can receive a common quantity for selected days, override one day, then edit an existing day's quantity without duplicating the allocation.
steps: Add a student and select issue passes now
Set common quantity to 2 and select all nine event days; verify every selected day's quantity field visibly becomes 2
Verify the total value equals the sum of each selected day's event price multiplied by its quantity
Override Day 5 quantity to 5 and save the student
Edit the student and increase Day 5 quantity from 5 to 6
Open the QR PDF and scan the Day 5 QR once
expected: The student and allocations save; selected days visibly inherit the common quantity, prices and total recalculate using each day's own price, a per-day override is preserved, Day 5 shows 6 passes after edit, the amount due increases by the added pass value, the PDF shows the updated quantity, and one successful scan records all 6 passes for that day.

name: Reject QR passes scanned on the wrong calendar date
description: Verifies a valid issued QR cannot be used before or after the event's configured calendar date.
steps: Create an issued pass for an event dated tomorrow
Open Scan and scan that event's QR today
Review the scan result
expected: The scanner shows INVALID — WRONG DATE and does not record handover.

name: Save payment generates QR without opening WhatsApp
description: Verifies pass issuance creates the PDF while WhatsApp delivery remains a separate explicit action.
steps: Add a student and issue a pass with payment received
Save the payment and issue the pass
Review the Students page and dashboard
Choose WhatsApp PDF only when ready to message the student
expected: Issuing a pass does not download a PDF. QR PDF downloads only when selected. WhatsApp PDF generates one PDF and offers native file sharing to WhatsApp when supported; otherwise, it offers a single PDF download and only enables Open WhatsApp after that download starts.
